woe.text: In Edgewall, Ruby warns Kellan not to touch a sleeper because of the Wicked Slumber, then agrees to guide him to Dunbarrow in exchange for help finding her brother Peter.

A wolf-armored archer attacks them on the way, but Ruby leads Kellan through a pack of witchstalkers, and when she calls the Wolf Knight Peter he removes his helm and proves to be her brother, enchanted by the witch.
Having found her brother, Ruby keeps helping Kellan, climbing a beanstalk with him to the giants' castle of Stormkeld and later pressing on to Hylda's ice castle at Loch Larent.
When Kellan collapses from the cold, Ruby carries him toward the castle and crawls across the drawbridge, refusing to abandon him, and her selflessness convinces Hylda to give up her crown.

fdn.text: Ruby sets out to find her brother.
